{{Quote|Calhava bru'chun dralshye'ran!|The bomber's words as he committed suicide|audio=CalhavaBruchunDralshyeran-TMP.flac|<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>}}
This '''Human male''' was a member of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:Death_Watch_bomber_dying.png|thumb|left|200px|Dutchess Satine kneels over the dying bomber]]
This Death Watch member was responsible for the [[Attack on the Memorial Shrine/Legends|bombing]] of the [[Memorial Shrine/Legends|Memorial Shrine]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. After fleeing the scene, he was cornered on a balcony by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. After firing a few shots at Kenobi he [[Death/Legends|killed himself]] by leaping from the balcony, instead of being captured. Before death, he spoke in the language of the people on [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], which led Obi-Wan to visit the moon, along with [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], whom was also present at the bombing of the memorial. His body was then transported to Concordia, where [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] saw to the remains and drafted a letter of condolence to the man's family.
